Privacy

This personal site doesn't add analytics, advertising trackers, contact forms or browser storage.

The creatures, physics and demo interactions run in your browser. Music and short edited sound effects are served by this site and played in your browser. Sound is enabled by default; if your browser blocks autoplay, the first interaction starts it. Separate music and effects sliders sit near the top; either can be lowered to silence. There is no embedded YouTube player or third-party audio request. Your pointer movements and scene choices aren't sent to a server. The fake interview does not use your camera or microphone.

Hosting and links

OpenAI Sites provides hosting and access control. That service handles requests and sign-in under its own privacy policy. This page describes the website's own code, not the hosting provider's logs or cookies.

External links take you to other sites with their own practices.
